lines.text: Wash the hands? Wash my hands!
Many learners say: I wash the hands before dinner.
Better: I wash my hands before dinner.
Your body: use my, not the.
My! I wash my hands before dinner.

data.wrong: I wash the hands before dinner.
data.right: I wash my hands before dinner.
data.why: Your body: use my, not the.

native.tip: En español “me lavo las manos”, pero en inglés se usa “my”: “wash my hands.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “I wash the hands before dinner.” Con partes del cuerpo se usa “my”, no “the”: “I wash my hands before dinner.” ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “my”. Con el cuerpo y la ropa se dice “my hands”, “my hair”, no “the hands”. Escribe una frase tuya con “my” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: Learners say “las manos”, but English says “my hands.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “I wash the hands before dinner.” With body parts use “my”, not “the”: “I wash my hands before dinner.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
